title: Account Management - Manager
jobDescription: Key Responsibilities Account Management & Customer Success Own end-to-end customer relationships, ensuring high satisfaction, retention, and engagement. Track and improve Voice of Customer (VOC) and Net Promoter Score (NPS) metrics. Proactively manage at-risk (RED) accounts and drive recovery plans. Lead stakeholder interactions, identify engagement gaps, and strengthen client relationships. Plan and execute customer engagement initiatives, events, and milestone communications. Program Management Office (PMO) & Delivery Governance Drive program delivery excellence, ensuring projects meet quality, timeline, and budget objectives. Monitor project financials, cost tracking, and profitability. Ensure adherence to project management best practices, tools, and governance frameworks. Facilitate audits, track deviations, and ensure timely closure through corrective actions. Coordinate with cross-functional teams and vendors to ensure seamless execution. Business Enablement & Sales Operations Manage CRM systems to ensure data accuracy, pipeline visibility, and reporting consistency. Support sales forecasting, pipeline tracking, and performance monitoring. Coordinate quote generation, proposals, order processing, and follow-ups on leads and renewals. Partner with Account Managers on renewals, upsell opportunities, and retention strategies. Collaborate with Finance on invoicing, payment tracking, and financial accuracy. Standardize sales processes, templates, and tools to improve efficiency and scalability. Data Analytics & Power BI Design and develop interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI. Track key metrics including sales performance, conversion rates, customer health, and program KPIs. Analyze data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for business growth and operational improvement. Integrate data from multiple systems (CRM, financials, project tools) into unified dashboards. Requirements Requirements Strong understanding of project management frameworks and customer lifecycle management. Hands-on experience with Power BI (dashboard creation, data modeling, visualization). Experience working with CRM tools and sales reporting systems. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field. MBA / PGDBM (Sales, Marketing, or Operations) preferred. Benefits Nucleus is well known for identifying, nurturing, and promoting the internal talent and having long mutually rewarding associations with its performing associates. Our focus programs help our associates to continuously grow based on their capability, performance, and career aspirations.

title: Executive - Corporate Communication
jobDescription: Role Overview We are looking for a creative, proactive, and detail-oriented professional to join the Corporate Communications team. The role will support the development and execution of internal and external communication initiatives across the organization. The ideal candidate should combine strong writing and storytelling skills with a good eye for visual communication and the ability to independently create professional communication assets using Canva. This role will work closely with multiple teams and stakeholders to translate business updates, employee initiatives, leadership messages, events, campaigns, and organizational milestones into clear, engaging, and brand-aligned communication. Key Responsibilities Content Writing & Storytelling Draft and edit content for internal and external communication channels Develop engaging copy for the emailers, internal campaigns, leadership communications, employee engagement initiatives, event communication, newsletters and magazines, social media posts, corporate announcements, posters and digital creatives, success stories and milestone communication. Convert business and technical information into simple, engaging, audience-friendly narratives. Proofread and edit content for grammar, tone, consistency, and accuracy. Maintain communication quality in line with organizational tone and brand guidelines. Visual Communication & Canva Create professional communication creatives independently using Canva to develop emailer designs, posters, social media creatives, presentation layouts, event communication assets, internal campaign creatives, invitations, digital banners & employee engagement communication Ensure visual consistency across communication assets Adapt existing templates while maintaining brand identity Work with design teams and external vendors for advanced creative requirements where required Internal Communications Support organisation-wide communication campaigns Coordinate communication for: Employee engagement initiatives, leadership messages, organizational announcements, events and celebrations, awards and recognitions, business milestones & product and customer updates Help drive employee awareness and participation through effective communication planning Support editorial calendars and communication schedules Corporate & External Communications Support development of corporate content for external audiences Assist with corporate profiles, award submissions, event communication, customer stories, leadership profiling, PR support content & social media communication. Conduct basic research to strengthen communication with relevant industry and market context Stakeholder Coordination Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather inputs and understand communication requirements Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely closure of content and creative deliverables Manage multiple communication requests while maintaining quality and timelines Follow up proactively for approvals, inputs, and dependencies Coordinate with agencies and vendors where required Requirements Must-Have Skills Strong written communication skills in English Excellent command of grammar, sentence structure, and professional business writing Ability to write clear, engaging, and audience-specific content Fluent and hands-on knowledge of Canva Ability to independently create professional visual communication assets Strong proofreading and editing skills Good understanding of corporate communication and internal communication Strong attention to detail Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines Good stakeholder management and coordination skills Proficiency in Microsoft Power Point and Microsoft Office tools Preferred Skills Experience in internal communications, corporate communications, content writing, marketing communications, or employer branding Understanding of social media content and digital communication Basic knowledge of visual storytelling and brand consistency Experience in newsletter, magazine, event, or employee communication Ability to research and simplify complex business or technology topics Familiarity with AI-enabled content and productivity tools will be an advantage Benefits Nucleus is well known for identifying, nurturing, and promoting the internal talent and having long mutually rewarding associations with its performing associates. Our focus programs help our associates to continuously grow based on their capability, performance, and career aspirations.

title: Technical Lead - Power BI
jobDescription: Nucleus Software has been providing Products and Services to various Global and Regional Financial institutions for the past 39 years. As a pioneer software vendor, Nucleus carries deep banking domain expertise and experience on latest technological trends. The platforms developed by Nucleus power the operations of more than 200 financial institutions in 50 countries, supporting multiple business verticals, accessible through mobile and internet channels. These platforms support retail banking, corporate banking, cash management, internet banking, automotive finance and other business areas. Key highlights about Nucleus include: Entrusted by Global and Regional banks as a preferred partner for their Traditional to Transformative journey Driving large Digitalization programs for various banks using Data Science, Cloud, AI/ML, Dev Ops, RPA based solutions. An organization with an “Employee First” outlook Recognized as a “Great Place to Work “by a global research organization Who We’re Looking For: Seeking a highly skilled and motivated Lead Power BI Analyst to drive business intelligence initiatives. Lead the design, development, and optimization of Power BI dashboards, reports, and data models. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver actionable insights. Mentor junior analysts to build team capability. Establish and implement best practices to scale Power BI analytics across the organization. Requirements Key Skills: Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Analytics, or related 6–8 years in BI/Analytics with 2+ years in a lead/senior role Expertise in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, RLS) and SQL (optimization, stored procedures, joins, views) Strong stakeholder management, problem-solving, and data storytelling skills Experience mentoring and leading small BI/analytics teams. Preferred Skills: Exposure to Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance Familiarity with Tableau, Qlik, or Python/R Benefits Nucleus is well known for identifying, nurturing, and promoting the internal talent and having long mutually rewarding associations with its performing associates. Our focus programs help our associates to continuously grow based on their capability, performance, and career aspirations. Over coming years, this role can evolve, to Program Manager, Program Director and further on.

title: Creative Lead
jobDescription: We are looking for a Creative Lead (AI-First Design Strategist) to lead design execution for the Marketing team & lead a team of designers, while working closely with the Design Head to ensure alignment with overall brand and design standards. This role requires a highly creative and strategic designer who can drive visual communication across multiple marketing channels, while leveraging AI-powered design tools and workflows to improve speed, creativity, and efficiency. Lead a team of designers, providing creative direction, mentorship, and quality oversight to ensure high-impact design output across all marketing initiatives. Own the end-to-end design function for Marketing, delivering compelling visual assets for product collaterals, website pages, social media campaigns, emailers, internal communications, print materials, and event branding. Translate marketing strategies and product narratives into clear, engaging visual communication that strengthens brand positioning and storytelling. Drive an AI-first design approach by leveraging generative AI and modern design tools to accelerate ideation, improve productivity, and scale creative production. Establish and maintain strong design standards, templates, and brand consistency across all touchpoints. Collaborate closely with marketing, product marketing, and communication teams to conceptualize and execute creative campaigns and launches. Manage multiple design projects and priorities, ensuring high quality, efficiency, and on-time delivery. Continuously elevate the creative bar by introducing new design trends, tools, and innovative visual approaches. Requirements 7+ years of proven experience in graphic design, preferably in B2B technology or digital marketing environments. Strong portfolio showcasing brand campaigns, digital marketing creatives, and modern design systems. Advanced skills in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva, and other industry-standard tools. Familiarity with AI design tools and generative AI workflows (e.g., Mid Journey, DALL·E, Firefly, Runway, Chat GPT for content adaptation). Strong understanding of typography, color theory, motion graphics, and UX principles for marketing design. Knowledge of emerging formats (interactive content, AR/VR visuals, short-form videos). Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or related field (Master’s preferred). Benefits At Nucleus Software, you’ll be part of a global Fin Tech leader, working on campaigns that shape the future of digital banking. We value creativity, innovation, and continuous learning, and we empower our designers to explore the latest tools, especially AI in design, to stay ahead of the curve.

title: Senior Manager Sales
jobDescription:
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Manager to drive strategic account growth and customer success in Africa Region. The ideal candidate will combine enterprise sales acumen with account management expertise, owning end-to-end client relationships — from lead generation and acquisition to delivery oversight, renewals, and expansion. This individual will act as a trusted advisor to clients, ensuring satisfaction, retention, and value realization, while achieving revenue growth and account profitability targets. Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Business Development & Sales Identify, qualify, and convert new business opportunities for Nucleus’s products and services (e.g., Finn One Neo, Finn Axia, IT Services). Generate and manage a robust pipeline of Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) to meet revenue targets (USD 2M annual target or as defined). Execute the complete sales cycle — lead generation, qualification, pitch, proposal, negotiation, and closure. Collaborate with Marketing for campaigns, events, ABM initiatives, and lead generation activities. Develop customized value propositions, presentations, and proposals aligned with client needs. Analyze regional markets, competition, and trends to formulate and execute sales strategies. Account Management & Customer Success Own the end-to-end customer relationship — ensuring satisfaction, retention, and engagement. Drive Voice of Customer (VOC), NPS improvements, and proactive management of at-risk (RED) accounts. Manage renewals, upselling, and cross-selling opportunities. Plan and lead customer engagement activities, such as events, meetups, and milestone celebrations. Ensure seamless onboarding of new clients and transition to delivery teams. Act as a single point of contact between customer stakeholders and internal delivery teams. Account Strategy & Growth Develop and execute account growth plans aligned with customer and organizational goals. Drive account retention and risk mitigation initiatives. Identify opportunities for new solution areas and change requests to expand account footprint. Track account performance metrics — renewals, revenue realization, and profitability. Contract & Financial Governance Oversee AMC renewals, contract addendums, and payment follow-ups. Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and accurate documentation. Track and report account-level financials, aging, and profitability. Coordinate with Finance, Legal, and Delivery teams for smooth contract governance. Delivery & Program Excellence Oversee program delivery and ensure adherence to timelines, budget, and quality standards. Track project financials, resource utilization, and delivery KPIs. Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer expectations are met and exceeded. Monitor program progress using Microsoft Project (MSP) and related tools. Relationship Building & Market Engagement Build trust-based relationships with CXO-level stakeholders, customers, and partners. Serve as a strategic liaison, ensuring alignment between customer objectives and Nucleus’s offerings. Participate in industry events, webinars, and customer forums to strengthen brand visibility and engagement. Gather and share market intelligence and customer insights with product and leadership teams. Requirements Skills: 18+ years of total experience in Enterprise Sales / Account Management within Software / IT Services / BFSI domain. Proven track record of managing large enterprise accounts and achieving sales targets for Africa region. Strong knowledge of banking and financial services industry and digital transformation trends. Proficiency in Project/Program Management, Contract Governance, and Customer Relationship Management. Hands-on experience with MS Project, CRM tools, and financial tracking. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating across business, delivery, and leadership teams. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, or related field. MBA/PGDBM (Sales / Marketing) preferred, PMP certification preferred. Benefits Future Career Progression: Nucleus is well known for identifying, nurturing, and promoting the internal talent and having long mutually rewarding associations with its performing associates. Our focus programs help our associates to continuously grow based on their capability, performance, and career aspirations.

title: Executive - Public Relations
jobDescription:
Role Overview We are looking for dynamic communications professional to support and drive Nucleus Software’s external and internal communication agenda. The role will focus on press releases, media engagement, thought leadership amplification, and brand storytelling, ensuring consistent, high-quality messaging across platforms. This role requires strong writing capability, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, stakeholder-driven environment. Key Responsibilities
1. Press Releases & Media Communication Draft, edit, and coordinate press releases aligned with business priorities, product launches, and corporate milestones Liaise with internal stakeholders (leadership, sales, product teams) to gather inputs and shape narratives Coordinate with PR agencies for dissemination across wires (ANI, PTI, IANS, etc.) and media publications Track and compile media coverage reports and visibility metrics
2. Media Relations & Outreach Support in building and maintaining relationships with journalists, editors, and media houses Assist in identifying media opportunities, interviews, and speaking platforms Ensure timely follow-ups with agencies and media for coverage, corrections, and amplification
3. Content & Thought Leadership Develop CXO-level content including authored articles, leadership quotes, and messaging notes Support creation of key communication assets (mailers, announcements, website content) Ensure messaging aligns with Nucleus’ brand voice: premium, precise, and insight-led
4. Campaign & Event Communication Support communication for events, customer engagements, and industry forums Coordinate pre-event, on-ground, and post-event communication (PR + social amplification) Assist in building narratives for flagship platforms (e.g., Synapse, industry events, media partnerships)
5. Internal Communication Support Contribute to internal communication initiatives including newsletters, leadership messages, and campaigns Ensure alignment between internal and external narratives
6. Reporting & Analysis Track PR performance including: Media coverage (quantity & quality) Share of voice Key publication highlights Maintain updated trackers for PR activities, media interactions, and campaigns Requirements Key Skills & Competencies Strong writing and editing skills (essential) Understanding of media landscape (business, BFSI, fin-tech) Ability to translate complex topics into clear, engaging communication Stakeholder management and coordination skills High attention to detail and adherence to timelines Basic understanding of digital and social media amplification Exposure to BFSI / fin-tech domain will be an advantage Benefits Nucleus is well known for identifying, nurturing, and promoting the internal talent and having long mutually rewarding associations with its performing associates. title: Assistant Manager - Product Marketing
jobDescription: We are seeking a seasoned Product Marketing Manager to drive global positioning, messaging, and demand for Finn Axia, our flagship lending platform. This role will be pivotal in shaping how the product is perceived across India, Middle East & Africa (MEA), and Southeast Asia (SEA), working closely with product, sales, and regional teams. The ideal candidate brings 8+ years of experience in the banking domain, with strong exposure to enterprise Saa S marketing, solution positioning, and GTM strategy. If you have built and positioned transaction banking products and want to take a global story across India, MEA and SEA this is your opportunity to shape the narrative of the leading transaction banking community – Finn Axia. Key Responsibilities include A. Product Positioning & Messaging Own and evolve Finn Axia’s value proposition across banks. Craft region-specific messaging aligned to market maturity (India vs MEA vs SEA) B. Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy Lead end-to-end GTM planning for product launches, upgrades, and regional expansion. Partner with regional sales to create Partner with regional sales to create market entry strategies for key geographies Align GTM with long sales cycles (12–18 months) typical of transaction banking platforms C. Sales Enablement Develop high-impact sales assets: pitch decks, battle cards, ROI calculators, case studies. Support large deal pursuits with customized storytelling and solution positioning. Train sales teams across regions on product narratives and differentiation D. Demand Generation & Campaigns Collaborate with demand gen teams to drive pipeline-building campaigns for both transformation for existing customers and GA releases for prospects. Design account-based marketing (ABM) programs for product positioning in strategic accounts. Leverage digital, events, partnerships, and analyst relations to build visibility E. Market & Competitive Intelligence Track competitor offerings (Newgen, Intellect, etc.) and build competitive intelligence frameworks Identify market trends in transaction banking (global payables, global receivables, FSCM, liquidity management) Translate insights into product and marketing strategies. F. Customer & Analyst Engagement Develop compelling customer success product stories and testimonials. Work with analysts (Gartner, Forrester, IBSi, etc.) to strengthen positioning. Represent the product in industry forums, events, and thought leadership platforms G. Cross-Functional Collaboration Act as the bridge between Product, Sales, Pre-sales, and Marketing Influence product roadmap based on market feedback and regional needs Requirements Requirement 10+ years in product marketing / solution marketing in banking domain. Strong experience in transaction banking platforms. Prior experience in companies like Intellect Design, China Systems, Newgen etc. Proven track record in global markets (India, MEA, SEA) Strong understanding of enterprise Saa S sales cycles and banking buyers Excellent storytelling, stakeholder management, and influencing skills Preferred Experience Exposure to Financial Supply Chain Management (FSCM), Liquidity Management, Trade Finance, Global Payables, Global Receivables Experience working with banks, specifically on transaction banking modules Familiarity with regulatory nuances across regions Experience in analyst relations, competitor intelligence and large deal support, Services Marketing

title: ISS - Network Administrator
jobDescription:
We are looking for a skilled Backup & Storage Administrator to manage enterprise backup, recovery, tape library, and storage infrastructure in a production environment. The role involves ensuring data protection, backup reliability, disaster recovery readiness, and storage availability across critical systems. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Manage enterprise backup and recovery operations using Commvault. • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve backup/storage-related incidents and failures. • Administer tape library operations including tape rotation, archival, and media management. • Manage Net App storage infrastructure including NAS/SAN, snapshots, replication, and storage provisioning. • Support disaster recovery activities, backup restorations, and infrastructure maintenance. • Collaborate with server, database, virtualization, and cloud teams for infrastructure support. • Ensure adherence to SLAs, compliance standards, and operational processes. Requirements ▪ Hands-on experience with Commvault backup administration. ▪ Experience in Tape Library management and archival operations. ▪ Strong knowledge of Net App storage administration (ONTAP, NAS, SAN, snapshots, replication). ▪ Good understanding of VMware, Windows, Linux, and enterprise infrastructure environments. ▪ Experience in incident management, troubleshooting, and disaster recovery support. ▪ Knowledge of scripting/automation and ITIL processes will be an added advantage.

title: Inside Sales (Managed)
jobDescription:
Role Summary: We are seeking a proactive Inside Sales professional to support Nucleus Software’s New Logo sales efforts across SEA. This role will focus on outbound prospecting, initial lead qualification, and providing routine back-office and contracting support to overseas field sales teams. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Outbound prospecting and cold calling to target accounts in assigned territories; build pipeline for field sales. Conduct initial qualification of inbound and outbound leads using BANT/MEDDPICC-style criteria and CRM. Schedule and coordinate discovery/demo meetings for overseas New Logo sales reps; manage calendars across time zones. Prepare and maintain accurate lead/contact/account records and activity logs in CRM (Salesforce preferred). Draft and manage routine sales documentation: NDAs, LOIs, quotes, SOW templates, and standard contracting paperwork in coordination with Legal/Contracts. Support pricing requests, track approvals, and ensure timely submission of proposals. Coordinate with product, customer success, and delivery teams for RFP/RFI responses and pre-sales materials. Follow-up on outstanding proposals, gather feedback, and update stakeholders on pipeline status. Provide regular reports and KPI updates (calls, qualified leads, conversion rates, pipeline value). Continuously improve outreach messaging, playbooks, and qualification scripts. Requirements Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
3–5 years’ experience in inside sales, sales development, or sales operations supporting enterprise software, fintech, or regulated B2B solutions. Proven cold-calling / outbound prospecting experience with consistent quota attainment or pipeline contribution. Should understand the BFSI Domain. Experience in Lending and Transaction Banking is preferred Understanding of local cultures, some of the languages across SEA is highly desirable Experience with CRM Systems is desirable. Should have good communication, presentation and knowledge about AI systems which can increase productivity Should collaborate with marketing for Event planning/coordination/getting crowd/CXO will also be one area Basic understanding of contracting processes and commercial terms for software sales. The candidate should also work with partners on existing leads Excellent verbal and written English; comfortable coordinating across SEA/APAC time zones. Strong organization, follow-through, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple tasks, and meet tight deadlines. Benefits Nucleus is well known for identifying, nurturing, and promoting the internal talent and having long mutually rewarding associations with its performing associates. Our focus programs help our associates to continuously grow based on their capability, performance, and career aspirations.

title: Solutions Specialist - Presales
jobDescription: Role Purpose- To support business development efforts by guiding and overseeing the demonstration and delivery of Nucleus’ platforms & solutions as a part of client sales pitches and provide support in client management at the demo stage. Areas of Responsibility- Product Demonstration- Participate in sales strategy meetings and offer inputs based on market/competitor information and internal analysis. Ensure that support is provided to sales teams during pitches through product demonstrations and presentations that best highlight the product’s features, utility and competitive advantage to potential clients. Engage, question, and participate in deep-dive discussions/ value workshops with customers and/or Sales team for thorough understanding of customers' existing scenarios, business drivers, pain-points, gaps, competition, core objectives; seek clarity on and understand customers' evaluation processes & key evaluation criteria. Lead and conduct clients demos or workshops for large account pitches and offer inputs based on client requirements and product features. Act as a product evangelist and highlight benefits of product features to clients as well as internal teams. Conduct GA Sanity Testing after GA release deployed in Pre-Sales servers. RFPs- Thoroughly review the RFP document to understand the client's requirements, evaluation criteria, and submission guidelines. Identify key stakeholders and subject matter experts needed for the response. Collaborate with technical experts to design a solution that meets the client's needs. Ensure the proposed solution aligns with the company's capabilities and strategic goals. Draft responses for each section of the RFP, including functional aspects and Executive Summary. Use existing content libraries and past proposals to streamline the writing process. Ensure that all responses comply with the RFP requirements and guidelines. Verify that all mandatory information and documents are included. Conduct internal reviews to ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency. Edit the content to improve readability and impact. Identify potential risks associated with the proposed solution and develop mitigation strategies. Document any assumptions and dependencies. Perform a final review of the entire RFP response to ensure completeness and quality. Prepare for potential presentations, demos or discussions with the client post-submission. Relationship Building- Liaise with client stakeholders and ensure all requirements are gathered in order to structure the product demos and other supporting collaterals Engage with prospective clients and industry leaders to understand business challenges and incorporate changes in internal procedures Process Improvement- Stay up to date with industry leading best practices and latest trends and offer insights to sales teams as well as product development teams. Implement new processes and tools to enhance the quality and efficiency of product demonstrations. People Management- Review MIS reports created by Pre-sales Executives; analyze and provide insights to senior stakeholders as required. Manage, mentor and inspire a team and team members including managing performance, goals and development potential, and evaluate potential new talent. Provide support to resolve conflict between multiple work streams / groups; provide inputs on goal setting and performance appraisals of team members; identify training needs for associates based on the client requirements. Facilitate knowledge sharing and best practices across the team; provide support to team members to achieve their knowledge goals and build expertise. jobDescription:
The Senior Manager for MEA (KSA & other selected geographies) Region will lead the sales and AM efforts for our flagship product, Finn One NEO, within the region. This role requires a dynamic and strategic leader with extensive experience in the BFSI sector, particularly in lending domain, to drive revenue growth, build strong client relationships, and oversee the execution of sales strategies in the market.
1. Strategic Sales Planning: Develop and implement a comprehensive sales strategy for the lending business in KSA and other selected geographies. Align sales strategies with overall business objectives and market trends to achieve revenue targets and growth.

7. Regulatory Compliance: Stay updated with local regulatory requirements and ensure all sales activities comply with industry regulations. Collaborate with compliance and legal teams to mitigate risks and address regulatory changes.
